Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.What You Bring:Technical Foundation- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.Core AI Skills- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.Professional Skills- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.Tech You Bring- SIEM/SOAR platforms- Logging and monitoring tooling- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms- Kubernetes ecosystem- GitHub for configuration and issue management- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages- Cloud computing environments- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana- Threat intelligence platforms- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNowMeet the Team:You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We work on real infrastructure problems, share what we learn, and believe a private cloud is something you build, not something you rent.​Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer (m/w/d) Aerospace (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES The What: At Blackwave GmbH, we develop and manufacture high-performance carbon fiber components for airplanes, rockets, and satellites — pushing the limits of lightweight design and precision manufacturing. Our mission: To end COPV failure in spaceflight. The benchmark for performance, reliability and cost efficiency.The Why: Because quality is the foundation of innovation. Every component we deliver must perform flawlessly under extreme conditions — in the air, in orbit, and beyond. As part of our Quality team, you ensure that our processes meet the highest standards, enabling us to turn cutting-edge ideas into flight-ready solutions.Important Note: This role is focused on Quality Assurance of our hardware (COPVs). We are not currently hiring for Software Quality Assurance positions• Project & Process Quality Assurance: You define and implement quality assurance strategies across the entire product lifecycle - from suppliers and development to serial production.• Manufacturing & Process Quality: You accompany production on the shop floor, working closely with manufacturing teams to ensure quality requirements are effectively implemented at all production stations.• Change Control: You support product and process changes, ensure quality requirements are considered and contribute to approval and implementation activities.• Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: You analyze quality deviations using structured methods (e.g. 8D, Ishikawa, 5-Why), derive sustainable corrective actions, and ensure their implementation.• Continuous Improvement & Audits: You monitor key quality indicators (e.g. audit findings, non-conformities) and proactively drive continuous improvement of processes and standards.YOUR PROFILE• Training & studies - You have completed degree in engineering, quality management, production technology, or a comparable qualification• Professional experience - You have relevant experience in quality planning and risk management, ideally in a manufacturing environment• Analytical Thinking & Root Cause Analysis: You are skilled at identifying patterns, isolating root causes (e.g. using 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa), and translating findings into actionable improvements• Standards & Compliance Knowledge: You are familiar with applicable quality standards and their practical implementation, as well as experience with ISO9001• Working Style & Mindset: You work independently, think in solutions, and enjoy deriving insights from quality data. You pursue excellence and value precision and reliability• Language skills - Very good written and spoken English, German is also nice to have for collaboration between departmentsWHAT WE OFFER• Personal responsibility & creative freedom: You actively contribute to the further development of our production technologies.• Flexible working hours & mobile working: Work-life balance is not an empty promise with us.• Start-up spirit meets aerospace: flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and room for innovation.• Individual benefits: Choose between a Germany ticket, Egym-Wellpass or a tax-free benefit in kind with the Give Card.• Fresh food every day: Shared lunch break with healthy, varied dishes.• Alpine view included: Our roof terrace invites you to relax after work.• Further development guaranteed: You will grow both professionally and personally through exciting projects and exchanges with experts.• We live and breathe team culture: whether it's a tech talk, team event or after-work - we celebrate successes together.About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Are you in?Your RoleKey responsibilities in your new role- Own the SDV strategy and define next generation microcontrollers related to new trends such as Ethernet, AI, Security and Safety within Infineon’s automotive Microcontroller business line- Capture requirements to define next generation products based on market trends and customer feedback- Seek business opportunities worldwide and own the pricing strategy to establish a growing and profitable market position- Define, execute, and improve our marketing and product strategy – engage in close collaboration with various stakeholders to optimize a product portfolio to enable successful business cases- Lead the go-to-market activities and manage the product life cycle- Proactively conduct market research by analyzing competitors and product competitiveness, identifying new potential markets, determining solution and product strategies, implementing new business models, and preparing market launchesYour ProfileQualifications and skills to help you succeed- A technical degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, industrial engineering or similar, ideally including a strong familiarity with the automotive microcontrollers market- More than 6 years of experience in technical marketing or field application engineering related tasks- Profound know-how on Ethernet, switches, RCP microcontrollers as well as strong understanding of technology trends- Profound know-how on SW such as Autosar, Rich OS, Automotive Linux and BSPs- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a technical, international environment- Enjoy taking the initiative, being energetic, thrive on delivering results, and working in an international team- Excellent English and ideally German communication skills as well as the fact that you are a good presenter of complex issues has always helped you master the need for alignment across internal and external contacts

jobs.occupation: Junior Technical Project Manager (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLEAt ERC System, we are developing next-generation eVTOL aircraft and building theprogramme structures required to turn ambitious aircraft concepts into executeddevelopment programmes.As a Junior Technical Project Manager, you will support and drive the day-to-dayengineering execution of assigned activities within our D250 and/or U250 aircraftprogrammes.Working within the Programme Management function and reporting to the ProgrammeManager, you will collaborate closely with the Chief Engineer and Integrated ProductTeam (IPT) Leads to coordinate engineering activities, challenge planning assumptions,identify risks and dependencies, and drive progress against agreed commitments.We are looking for someone who combines technical understanding with strongcommunication, initiative and ownership. You should be comfortable engaging withengineers, asking difficult questions and following through on issuesWHAT YOU WILL DO• Coordinate engineering execution: Drive day-to-day progress of assigned engineering activities across IPTs, ensuring deliverables, responsibilities and commitments are clear.• Manage engineering schedules: Develop and maintain detailed engineering work-package schedules with IPT Leads, challenge planning assumptions and monitor progress against agreed milestones.• Track risks and resolve blockers: Identify schedule deviations, technical dependencies and resource constraints, coordinate corrective actions and escalate issues requiring programme-level decisions.• Drive engineering coordination: Lead assigned IPT progress meetings, follow up on commitments and facilitate alignment between engineering teams on delivery-related matters.• Support milestone readiness: Coordinate planning and preparation for engineering design reviews, integration milestones and testing activities.• Provide execution visibility: Prepare clear progress updates, highlighting milestone status, schedule risks, recovery actions and decisions required by programme leadership.WHAT YOU BRING• Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineeringor a comparable technical field.• Initial experience in engineering project management, technical projectcoordination or complex product development, including substantial internshipsor working-student experience.• Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with engineers andtechnical stakeholders.• A proactive, persistent and solution-oriented approach, with the ability tochallenge assumptions and follow through on commitments.• Strong organisational and analytical skills, with an understanding of engineeringschedules, dependencies and resource constraints.• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and escalate issuesconstructively.• Fluent English communication skills.Preferred• Experience in aerospace, automotive, defence or another multidisciplinary engineering environment.• Familiarity with engineering development processes, design reviews, system integration and testing.• Experience with Microsoft Project or comparable project management tools.• German language skills are an advantage.WHAT WE OFFER• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on boardAbout usclick here!Built for purpose.When time matters.ERC was founded to close Europe's critical capability gap in the sky. Two full-scale demonstrators. Two EU records. Built for the missions that cannot wait.
